name: fist-pet-legacy-slot-safety
description: Real-input regression for duplicate legacy pet slots: exact-index equip/unequip, locked Delete guard, first-click no mutation, confirmation timeout, and exact-slot second-click Delete.

steps.label: start play and wait for both runtime DataModels
wait for gameplay bootstrap

args.code:
local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local p=assert(game.Players:GetPlayers()[1],'missing test player')
local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation
c:Invoke('Reset')
c:Invoke('SetStats',{PetInventoryJSON='["Forest Pup","Forest Pup","Miner Cat"]',EquippedPetsJSON='["Forest Pup"]',DiscoveredPetsJSON='["Forest Pup","Miner Cat"]',LockedPetsJSON='[]'})
p:SetAttribute('Flow30RawPetRequestSequence',0)
p:SetAttribute('Flow30RawPetRequestJSON','')
p:SetAttribute('LegacyPetServerResultSequence',0)
p:SetAttribute('LegacyPetServerResultAction','')
p:SetAttribute('LegacyPetServerResultToken','')
p:SetAttribute('LegacyPetServerResultIndex',0)
p:SetAttribute('LegacyPetServerResultOK',false)
p:SetAttribute('LegacyPetServerResultReason','')
local remote=game.ReplicatedStorage.PunchWallEvents.ActionRequest
remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(sender,request)
 if sender~=p or typeof(request)~='table' then return end
 local action=tostring(request.action or '')
 if action~='EquipPet' and action~='UnequipPet' and action~='DeletePet' and action~='LockPet' then return end
 p:SetAttribute('Flow30RawPetRequestSequence',(p:GetAttribute('Flow30RawPetRequestSequence') or 0)+1)
 p:SetAttribute('Flow30RawPetRequestJSON',H:JSONEncode(request))
end)
return H:JSONEncode({hooked=true,equipped=H:JSONDecode(p.RPGStats.EquippedPetsJSON.Value),rawSequence=p:GetAttribute('Flow30RawPetRequestSequence'),resultSequence=p:GetAttribute('LegacyPetServerResultSequence')})

steps.label: seed duplicate pet occurrences with only slot one equipped

args.code:
local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer
local g=p.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD
local GuiService=game:GetService('GuiService')
local RunService=game:GetService('RunService')
local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation
a:Invoke('OpenTab','Pets')
task.wait(.3)
local function expose(rowName,buttonName,expectedText)
 local c=g.GameMenu.Content
 local deadline=os.clock()+1.5
 local row,b
 repeat
  row=c:FindFirstChild(rowName)
  b=row and row:FindFirstChild('Actions') and row.Actions:FindFirstChild(buttonName)
  if b and b.AbsoluteSize.X>0 and b.AbsoluteSize.Y>0 then break end
  task.wait(.05)
 until os.clock()>=deadline
 assert(b,'missing fresh '..buttonName)
 c.CanvasPosition=Vector2.zero
 task.wait(.12)
 row=c:FindFirstChild(rowName)
 b=row and row:FindFirstChild('Actions') and row.Actions:FindFirstChild(buttonName)
 assert(b,'fresh '..buttonName..' vanished before layout settle')
 local desired=c.CanvasPosition.Y+(b.AbsolutePosition.Y+b.AbsoluteSize.Y*.5)-(c.AbsolutePosition.Y+c.AbsoluteSize.Y*.5)
 local maxY=math.max(0,c.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y-c.AbsoluteSize.Y)
 c.CanvasPosition=Vector2.new(0,math.clamp(desired,0,maxY))
 local function inspect()
  local currentRow=c:FindFirstChild(rowName)
  local current=currentRow and currentRow:FindFirstChild('Actions') and currentRow.Actions:FindFirstChild(buttonName)
  if not current then return {row=currentRow~=nil,button=false},nil end
  local center=current.AbsolutePosition+current.AbsoluteSize*.5
  local hits=p.PlayerGui:GetGuiObjectsAtPosition(math.floor(center.X),math.floor(center.Y))
  local ancestorVisible=true
  local ancestor=current
  while ancestor and ancestor~=g do
   if ancestor:IsA('GuiObject') and not ancestor.Visible then ancestorVisible=false break end
   ancestor=ancestor.Parent
  end
  ancestorVisible=ancestorVisible and ancestor==g and g.Enabled
  local inset=8
  local visibleArea=current.AbsolutePosition.X>=c.AbsolutePosition.X+inset and current.AbsolutePosition.Y>=c.AbsolutePosition.Y+inset and current.AbsolutePosition.X+current.AbsoluteSize.X<=c.AbsolutePosition.X+c.AbsoluteSize.X-inset and current.AbsolutePosition.Y+current.AbsoluteSize.Y<=c.AbsolutePosition.Y+c.AbsoluteSize.Y-inset
  local interactableAvailable,interactable=pcall(function() return current.Interactable end)
  return {row=true,button=true,text=current.Text,active=current.Active,selectable=current.Selectable,visible=current.Visible,interactableAvailable=interactableAvailable,interactable=interactableAvailable and interactable==true,ancestorVisible=ancestorVisible,visibleArea=visibleArea,topmost=hits[1]==current,top=hits[1] and hits[1]:GetFullName() or '',exactIndex=current:GetAttribute('ExactInventoryIndex'),confirmationArmed=current:GetAttribute('ConfirmationArmed'),callbackSequence=g:GetAttribute('LegacyPetActionCallbackSequence') or 0},current
 end
 local state,current
 local hitDeadline=os.clock()+1.25
 repeat
  task.wait(.05)
  state,current=inspect()
  if state.text==expectedText and state.active and state.selectable and state.visible and state.interactable and state.ancestorVisible and state.visibleArea and state.topmost then break end
 until os.clock()>=hitDeadline
 state=state or {row=false,button=false}
 assert(current and state.text==expectedText and state.active and state.selectable and state.visible and state.interactable and state.ancestorVisible and state.visibleArea and state.topmost,'fresh real-input precondition failed: '..H:JSONEncode(state))
 GuiService.SelectedObject=current
 local frames=0
 local frameConnection
 frameConnection=RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
  frames+=1
  if frames>=2 and frameConnection then frameConnection:Disconnect() frameConnection=nil end
 end)
 local frameDeadline=os.clock()+.5
 while frames<2 and os.clock()<frameDeadline do task.wait(.01) end
 if frameConnection then frameConnection:Disconnect() frameConnection=nil end
 assert(frames>=2,'bounded focus settle missed two RenderStepped frames')
 row=c:FindFirstChild(rowName)
 current=row and row:FindFirstChild('Actions') and row.Actions:FindFirstChild(buttonName)
 assert(current,'focused target vanished before real input')
 if GuiService.SelectedObject~=current then GuiService.SelectedObject=current end
 local finalState,observed=inspect()
 finalState.frames=frames
 finalState.reacquired=observed==current
 finalState.selected=GuiService.SelectedObject==current
 assert(finalState.text==expectedText and finalState.active and finalState.selectable and finalState.visible and finalState.interactable and finalState.ancestorVisible and finalState.visibleArea and finalState.topmost and finalState.reacquired and finalState.selected,'post-focus real-input precondition failed: '..H:JSONEncode(finalState))
 return finalState
end
local state=expose("#02  [Common] Forest Pup  *","Equip2","EQUIP")
g:SetAttribute('Flow30ExpectedCallbackSequence',state.callbackSequence+1)
return H:JSONEncode(state)

args.code:
local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local p=assert(game.Players:GetPlayers()[1],'missing test player')
local started=os.clock()
local deadline=started+2
local attempts=0
local state
while true do
 attempts+=1
 local e=H:JSONDecode(p.RPGStats.EquippedPetsJSON.Value)
 local rawText=p:GetAttribute('Flow30RawPetRequestJSON') or '{}'
 local rawOK,raw=pcall(H.JSONDecode,H,rawText)
 raw=rawOK and raw or {}
 state={count=#e,first=e[1],second=e[2],rawSequence=p:GetAttribute('Flow30RawPetRequestSequence') or 0,requestAction=raw.action,requestIndex=raw.index,resultSequence=p:GetAttribute('LegacyPetServerResultSequence') or 0,resultAction=p:GetAttribute('LegacyPetServerResultAction'),resultIndex=p:GetAttribute('LegacyPetServerResultIndex'),resultOK=p:GetAttribute('LegacyPetServerResultOK'),reason=p:GetAttribute('LegacyPetServerResultReason'),attempts=attempts,elapsed=os.clock()-started}
 state.exact=state.count==2 and state.first=='Forest Pup' and state.second=='Forest Pup' and state.rawSequence==1 and state.requestAction=='EquipPet' and state.requestIndex==2 and state.resultSequence==1 and state.resultAction=='EquipPet' and state.resultIndex==2 and state.resultOK==true and state.reason=='ok'
 if state.exact or os.clock()>=deadline then break end
 task.wait(math.min(.05,math.max(0,deadline-os.clock())))
end
assert(state.exact,'slot two authoritative Equip/request/result did not converge: '..H:JSONEncode(state))
return H:JSONEncode(state)
